name: text_stats_workflow
description: Function and tool nodes carrying real target-neutral bodies (ADR-0056). Deliberately free of agent nodes, so the generated project runs end to end with no model call — the live e2e cell costs zero API quota. Linear by design: a function cannot directly follow a router on ADK (finding F6).

config.description: Collapse whitespace and lowercase the incoming text.
Count words and characters in the normalized text.
Describe the measured text. The guard clause exercises an early return inside a body.
config.body:
if node_input.words == 0:
    return "empty passage"

density = node_input.chars / node_input.words
return f"{node_input.words} words, {density:.1f} chars/word"
